source: Original Fuel Log recipes. Nutrition computed from USDA SR26 and FNDDS values in foods.json; salt and spices not counted.

recipes.name: Protein overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, yogurt, milk and chia seeds together in a jar.
Top with the blueberries and honey, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Eat cold, or warm it for a minute in the microwave.
recipes.tip: Make three jars on Sunday for an easy start to the week.

recipes.name: Spinach and feta egg scramble
steps: Warm the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and soften the pepper for 2 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until it wilts.
Whisk the eggs and whites, pour them in, and stir gently until just set.
Sprinkle with feta and serve with the toast.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese berry bowl
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with the berries, walnuts and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana protein smoothie
ing: Ice and a pinch of cinnamon
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Add a splash more almond milk if it's too thick.

recipes.name: Freezer breakfast burritos
ing: 1 tsp chili powder and 1/2 tsp cumin
steps: Brown the turkey with the spices, then stir in the beans.
Scramble the eggs in the same pan until just set.
Fill each tortilla with turkey, eggs, cheese and salsa, and roll tightly.
Wrap each burrito in foil and freeze. Reheat for 2 minutes in the microwave (remove the foil first).

fz.how: Wrap each burrito in foil and freeze. Unwrap and microwave 2 to 2 1/2 minutes, turning once.

recipes.name: Veggie egg muffin cups
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Divide the vegetables and cheese between the cups.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and pour them over the vegetables.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes, until set in the middle.
recipes.tip: One serving is 2 muffins. They keep 4 days in the fridge.

fz.how: Freeze on a tray, then bag. Microwave 60 to 90 seconds.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt parfait
steps: Layer the yogurt, raspberries and granola in a glass.
Finish with the honey.

recipes.name: Avocado toast with eggs
steps: Toast the bread and mash the avocado on top with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Cook the eggs how you like them and lay one on each slice.
Finish with chili flakes.

recipes.name: Chicken burrito bowl
ing: 1 tbsp lime juice, 1 tsp each chili powder and cumin
steps: Rub the chicken with the spices and a pinch of salt, then grill or pan-cook 6 to 7 minutes a side.
Let it rest 5 minutes and slice.
Divide the rice, beans, corn and lettuce between 4 bowls.
Top with chicken, salsa, sliced avocado and a squeeze of lime.
recipes.tip: Packs well for 4 days of lunches. Add the avocado the day you eat it.

fz.how: Freeze the chicken, rice, beans and corn in containers. Add the lettuce, salsa and avocado after reheating.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt tuna wrap
ing: 1/4 cup diced celery and red onion
steps: Mix the tuna, yogurt, mustard, onion and celery with salt and pepper.
Lay the spinach on the tortilla, add the tuna salad, and roll it up.

recipes.name: Mediterranean quinoa chickpea salad
steps: Whisk the oil and lemon juice with salt, pepper and a pinch of oregano.
Toss everything else together in a big bowl.
Pour over the dressing and toss again. It tastes better after an hour in the fridge.

recipes.name: Turkey and hummus pita
steps: Spread the hummus inside the pita.
Fill with turkey and vegetables.

recipes.name: Lighter chicken Caesar wrap
ing: 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp mustard, 1 garlic clove
steps: Whisk the yogurt, parmesan, lemon, mustard and grated garlic into a dressing.
Toss the romaine and chicken with the dressing.
Divide between the tortillas and roll up.

recipes.name: Hearty lentil and vegetable soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and cumin.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and broth. Simmer 25 to 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach and season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.tip: Use vegetable broth to keep it vegetarian. Freezes well.

fz.how: Cool, then freeze in portions. Reheat on the stove or microwave 3 to 4 minutes, stirring halfway.

recipes.name: Teriyaki salmon rice bowl
steps: Stir the soy sauce, honey, ginger and sesame oil together.
Brush half over the salmon and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 12 minutes.
Divide the rice, edamame and cucumber between bowls, add the salmon, and drizzle with the rest of the sauce.

recipes.name: High-protein egg salad
steps: Chop the eggs and mix with the yogurt, mustard, green onion, salt and pepper.
Serve on toast or in lettuce cups.

recipes.name: Black bean and veggie quesadilla
ing: 1 can black beans, rinsed and mashed
steps: Spread the beans over half of each tortilla and top with pepper, corn and cheese.
Fold and cook in a dry pan, 3 minutes a side, until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Sheet-pan chicken and vegetables
ing: 1 1/2 lb chicken breast, cut in chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss everything with the oil and spices on a large sheet pan in one layer.
Roast 25 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are browned.
recipes.tip: One pan, done. Leftovers make good lunches.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Reheat in the oven or microwave. The vegetables soften a little.

recipes.name: Lean turkey chili
ing: 2 cans kidney or black beans, rinsed
2 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 3 garlic cloves
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil, then add the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and spices for a minute.
Add the beans and tomatoes and simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Top with Greek yogurt instead of sour cream if you like.
recipes.tip: Freezes in portions for up to 3 months.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Reheat from frozen on the stove, or thaw overnight and microwave.

recipes.name: Lemon garlic salmon with asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put the salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan, drizzle with oil, lemon and garlic, and season.
Roast 12 to 15 minutes. Serve with the quinoa.

recipes.name: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
ing: 1 lb 90% lean ground beef or sliced flank steak
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic and sesame oil with 2 tbsp water.
Brown the beef in a hot pan and set it aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli with a splash of water for 4 minutes.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce, and toss for a minute. Serve over rice.

fz.how: Freeze with the rice in portions. The broccoli softens a little after freezing.

recipes.name: Shrimp tacos with cabbage slaw
steps: Toss the shrimp with the spices and cook in a hot pan 2 minutes a side.
Mix the cabbage with the yogurt, half the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas, fill with slaw, shrimp and avocado, and finish with lime and cilantro.

recipes.name: Turkey meatballs with marinara and pasta
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix the turkey, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan and Italian seasoning, and roll into 16 balls.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes.
Simmer the meatballs in the marinara for 5 minutes and serve over the pasta.

fz.how: Freeze the meatballs in sauce. Cook pasta fresh when you reheat.

recipes.name: Crispy tofu vegetable stir-fry
ing: 1 block extra-firm tofu (14 oz), pressed and cubed
1 cup snap peas or green beans
steps: Pan-fry the tofu in half the oil until golden on all sides, then set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the rest of the oil for 4 to 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic, and toss until glossy.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Turkey and quinoa stuffed peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut the tops off the peppers and scoop out the seeds.
Brown the turkey, then stir in the quinoa, tomatoes and seasoning.
Pack the filling into the peppers, cover with foil and bake 25 minutes.
Top with cheese and bake 5 more minutes uncovered.

fz.how: Freeze before the cheese goes on. Bake from frozen at 375°F (190°C) for 40 to 45 minutes, adding cheese at the end.

recipes.name: Herb pork tenderloin with roasted potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss the potatoes with half the oil and roast 15 minutes.
Rub the pork with the rest of the oil and herbs, sear it on all sides, and add it to the pan with the green beans.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes, until the pork reaches 145°F (63°C). Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Chickpea and spinach curry
steps: Soften the onion in the oil, then add garlic, ginger and curry powder for a minute.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts. Serve over rice.
recipes.tip: Uses about half a can of regular coconut milk. Light coconut milk cuts the fat further.

fz.how: Freeze the curry in portions. Make rice fresh or freeze it separately.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
ing: 1/2 cup salsa and 1/2 cup Greek yogurt
steps: Toss the chicken with the seasoning.
Cook it in a hot pan with half the oil until browned, then set aside.
Cook the peppers and onion in the rest of the oil until soft and charred at the edges.
Return the chicken, squeeze over lime, and serve in warm tortillas with salsa and yogurt.

fz.how: Freeze the chicken and pepper filling. Warm tortillas and add salsa and yogurt fresh.

recipes.name: No-bake peanut butter protein bites
steps: Stir everything together. Add a splash of milk if it's too dry to hold.
Roll into 24 balls and chill 30 minutes.
Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

fz.how: Freeze in a bag. Thaw 10 minutes, or eat straight from the freezer.

recipes.name: Hummus and veggie snack box
steps: Pack the hummus in a small container with the vegetables around it.

recipes.name: Apple with peanut butter
steps: Slice the apple and dip or spread with peanut butter.

recipes.name: Homemade trail mix
steps: Mix everything and divide into 8 small bags or containers (about 1/4 cup each).
recipes.tip: Portion it out ahead of time. Trail mix is easy to overeat straight from the bag.

recipes.name: Ranch cottage cheese dip
ing: Dill, garlic powder, onion powder, lemon
steps: Blend the cottage cheese and yogurt until smooth.
Stir in the herbs and seasonings, and serve with vegetables.

recipes.name: Garlic chili edamame
steps: Cook the edamame according to the package.
Toss with sesame oil, garlic, chili flakes and salt.

recipes.name: Frozen berry yogurt bark
steps: Stir the honey into the yogurt and spread it 1/2 inch thick on a parchment-lined tray.
Scatter the berries and chocolate on top.
Freeze 3 hours, then break into pieces. Keep frozen.

fz.how: Keep it frozen. Eat straight from the freezer.

recipes.name: Tuna rice cakes
steps: Mix the tuna with the yogurt.
Spread on the rice cakes and top with cucumber and seasoning.

recipes.name: Blender protein pancakes
steps: Blend the oats, banana, eggs, cottage cheese, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth.
Cook 1/4-cup scoops in a lightly oiled nonstick pan, about 2 minutes a side.
Serve with blueberries and maple syrup.

fz.how: Freeze flat with parchment between pancakes. Reheat in the toaster or microwave 45 seconds.

recipes.name: Turkey sausage egg muffin
steps: Toast the muffin.
Brown the sausage and fry the egg in the same pan.
Stack the egg, sausage and cheese on the muffin.
recipes.tip: Make five, wrap them in foil, and freeze for grab-and-go mornings.

fz.how: Wrap each sandwich in parchment and freeze. Microwave 90 seconds wrapped in a paper towel.

recipes.name: Huevos rancheros
steps: Warm the beans with half the salsa.
Crisp the tortillas in a dry pan and fry the eggs.
Top each pair of tortillas with beans, two eggs, the rest of the salsa, avocado and cheese.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with feta
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes.
Make six wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 5 to 7 minutes until the whites set.
Scatter with feta and serve with warm pita.

recipes.name: Chocolate protein oatmeal
steps: Cook the oats in the milk for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring.
Take it off the heat and stir in the protein powder and cocoa.
Top with banana and peanut butter.

recipes.name: Berry smoothie bowl
steps: Blend the berries, yogurt and banana until thick. Add a splash of milk only if the blender stalls.
Pour into a bowl and top with granola and chia.

recipes.name: Mushroom and spinach omelet
steps: Cook the mushrooms and onion in the oil until soft, then wilt the spinach and set aside.
Pour the beaten eggs into the pan and cook until almost set.
Add the vegetables and cheese to one half, fold, and cook a minute more.

recipes.name: Savory cottage cheese toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with cottage cheese, top with tomato, and finish with seasoning and pepper.

recipes.name: Greek chicken couscous bowl
steps: Rub the chicken with oil, lemon, oregano and garlic, then grill or roast until cooked through.
Slice it and divide between bowls with the couscous and vegetables.
Top with feta and a spoonful of tzatziki.

recipes.name: Crunchy Asian chicken salad
ing: 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil
steps: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, sesame oil and a little grated ginger.
Toss the cabbage, carrots, edamame and chicken with the dressing.
Top with peanuts, green onion and cilantro.
recipes.tip: Keep the peanuts separate if you're packing it for later so they stay crunchy.

recipes.name: Lighter Cobb salad
ing: 1/3 cup Greek yogurt ranch (yogurt, dill, garlic)
steps: Arrange the lettuce in two bowls and add rows of chicken, egg, bacon, avocado and tomato.
Stir the yogurt with dill, garlic powder and lemon for a quick ranch, and drizzle over.

recipes.name: Lemony tuna chickpea salad
steps: Toss everything together with salt and pepper.
Eat right away or keep it in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.name: Turkey taco lettuce wraps
steps: Brown the turkey with the taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Spoon it into lettuce leaves and top with salsa, cheese and avocado.

fz.how: Freeze the seasoned turkey. Add the lettuce and toppings fresh.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the broth, herbs and whole chicken breasts and simmer 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, return it to the pot, and stir in the cooked noodles.
recipes.tip: Cook the noodles separately if you're freezing it, so they don't go soft.

fz.how: Freeze the soup without the noodles. Add freshly cooked noodles when you reheat.

recipes.name: Pesto chicken panini
steps: Spread the pesto on the bread.
Layer the chicken, mozzarella, tomato and spinach.
Press in a hot pan or panini press for 3 to 4 minutes a side until golden and melted.

recipes.name: Smoky black bean soup
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the beans, salsa and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend about half the soup and stir it back in. Serve with a spoonful of yogurt.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Reheat until steaming and add the yogurt after.

recipes.name: Shrimp and avocado salad
steps: Toss everything together with salt, pepper and a pinch of chili.
Serve right away, on its own or over greens.

recipes.name: Hummus and feta veggie wrap
steps: Spread the hummus over the tortilla.
Add the vegetables and feta and roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Egg roll in a bowl
steps: Brown the turkey with garlic and ginger.
Add the cabbage and carrots and stir-fry until just tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the soy sauce and sesame oil and top with green onion.
recipes.tip: All the flavor of an egg roll without the wrapper or the fryer.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Microwave 2 to 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Lemon baked cod with potatoes and green beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Roast the halved potatoes with half the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the green beans and cod to the pan, drizzle with the rest of the oil, lemon and garlic.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes, until the fish flakes. Finish with parsley.

recipes.name: Lighter chicken tikka masala
ing: 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
Garam masala, cumin, turmeric, garlic, ginger
steps: Coat the chicken in the yogurt and half the spices and marinate at least 20 minutes.
Sear the chicken in the oil until browned, then set aside.
Cook the onion with the rest of the spices, add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then blend smooth.
Return the chicken, stir in the coconut milk, and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with rice.

fz.how: Freeze the curry in portions with or without rice. Microwave 3 to 4 minutes, stirring halfway.

recipes.name: Sirloin steak with sweet potato and broccoli
steps: Roast the cubed sweet potato and broccoli with the oil at 425°F (220°C) for 20 minutes.
Season the steak and sear it in a very hot pan, 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium-rare.
Rest 5 minutes, slice against the grain, and serve with the vegetables.

recipes.name: Lighter spaghetti bolognese
ing: 1 carrot and 1 celery stalk, finely diced
steps: Brown the beef, then add the onion, carrot and celery and cook 5 minutes.
Add the sauce and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and serve with parmesan.
recipes.tip: The finely diced vegetables add volume and fiber without changing the taste much.

fz.how: Freeze the sauce. Cook pasta fresh when you reheat.

recipes.name: Kung pao-style chicken
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in the oil until browned.
Add the peppers and zucchini and cook 4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger and chili and toss until glossy.
Top with peanuts and serve over rice.

fz.how: Freeze without the peanuts, with the rice in portions. Add the peanuts after reheating.

recipes.name: Pineapple teriyaki chicken
ing: 1 1/2 lb chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
1 can pineapple chunks in juice, drained
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss the chicken, pineapple and pepper with the teriyaki sauce on a sheet pan.
Roast 20 to 25 minutes. Serve over rice with green onion.

fz.how: Freeze with the rice in portions. Microwave 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Herb tilapia with couscous
steps: Season the fish with dill, garlic, lemon, salt and pepper.
Cook it in half the oil, 3 minutes a side.
Sauté the zucchini and tomatoes in the rest of the oil and serve with the fish and couscous.

recipes.name: Greek turkey burgers
steps: Mix the turkey, feta, spinach, oregano and garlic and shape into 4 patties.
Grill or pan-cook 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked through.
Serve in warm pitas with tzatziki and vegetables.

fz.how: Freeze the cooked patties with parchment between them. Reheat in a pan or microwave. Add the tzatziki and vegetables fresh.

recipes.name: Lentil bolognese
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil.
Add the lentils, sauce and 1 1/2 cups water and simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Toss with the pasta and top with parmesan.

fz.how: Freeze the sauce. Cook pasta fresh when you reheat.

recipes.name: Peanut tofu noodles
steps: Pan-fry the cubed tofu in the sesame oil until crisp.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime and a few tablespoons of hot water into a sauce.
Toss the noodles, cabbage, carrots and tofu with the sauce.

recipes.name: Salsa verde pork bowls
steps: Cut the pork into 1-inch pieces and brown them in a little oil.
Add the salsa verde, cover, and simmer 20 minutes until tender, then shred.
Serve over rice with beans, corn, cilantro and lime.

fz.how: Freeze the shredded pork in its sauce. Reheat and serve over rice and beans.

recipes.name: Garlic shrimp pasta with spinach
steps: Cook the garlic and chili in the oil for a minute, then add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes a side.
Add the spinach and stir until it wilts.
Toss with the pasta, lemon and parmesan, adding a splash of pasta water if it's dry.

recipes.name: Turkey sausage and veggie sheet pan
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Roast the halved potatoes with the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the sausage and vegetables, toss with the seasoning, and roast 15 to 20 minutes more.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Reheat in a hot oven or skillet to crisp the potatoes back up.

recipes.name: Lean beef tacos
steps: Brown the beef with the taco seasoning and a splash of water.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with beef, lettuce, tomato, cheese and salsa.

fz.how: Freeze the seasoned beef. Add the toppings fresh.

recipes.name: Red lentil dal
ing: Garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, garam masala
steps: Cook the onion in the oil until golden, then add the garlic, ginger and spices for a minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 4 cups water and simmer 20 minutes until thick.
Stir in the spinach and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with rice.

fz.how: Freeze in portions. Add a splash of water when reheating, since it thickens.

recipes.name: Baked chicken parmesan
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Dip the chicken in beaten egg, then in the breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan, and bake on a rack 15 minutes.
Spoon sauce over each piece, top with mozzarella, and bake 5 more minutes.
Serve with pasta and the rest of the sauce.

fz.how: Freeze the cooked chicken with sauce and cheese. Bake from frozen at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate protein pudding
steps: Stir everything together until smooth and thick.
Chill 10 minutes if you can, or eat right away.

recipes.name: Crispy roasted chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat the chickpeas very dry.
Toss with the oil and spices and roast 30 to 35 minutes, shaking the pan halfway, until crunchy.
Let them cool on the pan so they crisp up more.

recipes.name: 3-ingredient banana oat cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mash the bananas and stir in the oats, peanut butter and chocolate.
Scoop 12 cookies onto a lined tray and bake 12 to 15 minutes.

fz.how: Freeze in a bag. Thaw 15 minutes or warm 15 seconds.

recipes.name: Turkey and Swiss roll-ups
steps: Spread the turkey slices with mustard.
Lay a strip of cheese and a cucumber spear on each slice and roll up.

recipes.name: Parmesan popcorn
steps: Toss the warm popcorn with the oil, then the parmesan and a pinch of black pepper.
recipes.tip: Three cups of popcorn is a big bowl for under 150 calories.

recipes.name: Cottage cheese with pineapple
steps: Spoon the pineapple over the cottage cheese.

recipes.name: Pumpkin pie protein yogurt
steps: Stir the pumpkin, maple and spice into the yogurt.
Top with granola.

recipes.name: Everything bagel eggs
steps: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool in cold water, and peel.
Halve and sprinkle with seasoning. Serve with tomatoes.
recipes.tip: Boil a dozen at once. They keep a week in the fridge in their shells.

recipes.name: Chocolate date energy balls
steps: Pulse the almonds in a food processor until finely chopped.
Add the dates and cocoa and blend until it sticks together.
Roll into 16 balls and chill.

fz.how: Freeze in a bag. Thaw 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Peanut butter chocolate banana bites
steps: Sandwich a little peanut butter between pairs of banana slices.
Dip halfway in melted chocolate and freeze on parchment for an hour.

fz.how: Keep them frozen. Eat straight from the freezer.
